subject.title: Add auth sync command or auto-sync for API key rotation across agents

question: Should OpenClaw handle env-backed API-key rotation shadowing with an explicit operator-controlled repair/warning path, automatic auth-store sync on config/env writes, or runtime fallback after credential failure?
rationale: Each viable direction changes credential copying, stored-auth precedence, or recovery behavior across agent auth stores, so automation should not choose the security boundary on its own.

options.title: Operator-controlled repair and warning
options.body: Add doctor/status/models-auth detection plus an explicit fix path that updates canonical SQLite auth stores only after user confirmation.

options.title: Automatic sync on config/env update
options.body: Propagate supported static keys into affected agent auth stores automatically, accepting a larger silent secret-copying blast radius.

options.title: Runtime fallback after auth failure
options.body: Try env/config credentials after a stored profile fails, accepting a more surprising auth precedence model.

recommendation.title: Operator-controlled repair and warning
recommendation.body: Add doctor/status/models-auth detection plus an explicit fix path that updates canonical SQLite auth stores only after user confirmation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on SQLite auth storage and credential resolution semantics touched by this decision.
